basic_details.job_title: GBPNIHE Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 DEO, Research Officer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The G. B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (GBPNIHE), Kosi-Katarmal, Almora (Uttarakhand), has invited applications from Indian citizens for 4 project-based temporary positions: 2 Research Officer at Rs. 50,000 + HRA, 1 Junior Project Fellow (JPF) at Rs. 24,000 + HRA (as per norms) and 1 Data entry Operator at Rs 18,000 per month (fixed). Apply online at the recruitment portal https://gbpihed.gov.in/vacancy.php by 11:59 PM on 03 December 2026; walk-in interviews are on 08 December 2026 from 10:00 am at GBPNIHE, Kosi-Katarmal, Almora.

how_to_apply: Submit the application through the online recruitment portal, https://gbpihed.gov.in/vacancy.php, only on or before 11:59 PM on 03 December 2026.
Mention in the application all qualifications and experience in the relevant field over and above the minimum prescribed qualification, supported with documents.
Candidates who have completed the online application form will be called for the walk-in interview on 08 December 2026 from 10:00 am onwards at GBPNIHE, Kosi-Katarmal, Almora (Uttarakhand).
Original documents of educational qualifications and experience, with one set of photocopies, to be brought to the interview.
Experience certificate: experience will not be considered without it.
important_instructions: Candidates appearing for the interview (physically) must bring original documents of educational qualifications and experience, with one set of photocopies. The selected candidates are expected to join immediately. The selected candidate is liable to be posted anywhere in India. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview. The Institute reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of positions, or to fill up or not fill any or all the posts. Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification. The Institute's decision on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection and conduct of the interview is final; no query or correspondence will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: GBPNIHE Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: G. B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment, Kosi-Katarmal, Almora (Uttarakhand)

"Climate Risk Assessment and Climate-Resilient Horticulture Planning under Uttarakhand Integrated Horticulture Development Project (UKIHDP)"; "Inventorization of Taxonomic Diversity, Habitat Mapping, Conservation and Livelihood Linkages of the Aroid Flora in the Eastern Himalaya and Northeast India"; "Creation of an Integrated Database of the Himalayan Biodiversity for Mainstreaming in Policy to meet National Commitments."
UKIHDP (Research Officer); NMHS (Junior Project Fellow, Data entry Operator)
Research Officer; Junior Project Fellow (JPF); Data entry Operator
Rs. 50,000 + HRA; Rs. 24,000 + HRA (as per norms); Rs 18,000/month (fixed)

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: G. B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment is based at Kosi-Katarmal, Almora, Uttarakhand. This notice fills project-based temporary positions in projects funded by UKIHDP and NMHS, covering climate-resilient horticulture planning, aroid flora of the Eastern Himalaya and Northeast India, and a Himalayan biodiversity database.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces 4 positions in total. The notice gives no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited only from Indian citizens. Candidates should have the required qualifications in the relevant subject or specialization, with consistently good academic records and experience. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. It does state that minimum qualification and/or experience requirements can be relaxed for exceptionally outstanding candidates. Experience in socio-economic and community-based research with proficiency in participatory methods, climate vulnerability assessment, livelihood analysis and stakeholder engagement. Experience in vegetation survey/ taxonomy/ database management with reference to the north-eastern region of India. Experience in forest inventories/ Remote Sensing and GIS with reference to Himalaya. Preference will be given to candidates having working experience in the Himalaya. Preference will be given to candidates having relevant work experience in R&D related research projects in the Himalayan region.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's degree in Life Sciences/ Agriculture/ Horticulture, with relevant experience of 3 years
First Class Master degree in Botany/ Forestry/ Remote Sensing & GIS/ Ecology/ Environment Science/ Life Science or relevant discipline from a recognized university
Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Research Officer gets Rs. 50,000 + HRA. JPF gets Rs. 24,000 + HRA (as per norms). Data entry Operator gets Rs 18,000 per month (fixed). The positions are project-based and purely temporary in nature. The Institute reserves the right to disengage the manpower at any time without assigning any reasons. The notice does not state the tenure.

content_sections.heading: GBPNIHE Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Data collection activities, data analysis, assessments, field coordination and report writing. To conduct field based vegetation assessment and database management. Spatial analysis and report writing. Biodiversity data entry and field surveys in different regions of the Indian Himalaya to collect biodiversity data.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GBPNIHE Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Submit the application through the online recruitment portal, https://gbpihed.gov.in/vacancy.php , only on or before 11:59 PM on 03 December 2026. Mention in the application all qualifications and experience in the relevant field over and above the minimum prescribed qualification, supported with documents. Candidates who have completed the online application form will be called for the walk-in interview on 08 December 2026 from 10:00 am onwards at GBPNIHE, Kosi-Katarmal, Almora (Uttarakhand). Original documents of educational qualifications and experience, with one set of photocopies, to be brought to the interview. Experience certificate: experience will not be considered without it.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Walk-in interviews are held for candidates who have completed the online application form. Meeting the minimum advertised qualification and experience does not automatically entitle an applicant to be called for an interview or test. If many applications are received, the Institute reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility level to limit the number of candidates called, and its decision is final. It may also shortlist and select candidates in any suitable position depending on qualification and experience.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates appearing for the interview (physically) must bring original documents of educational qualifications and experience, with one set of photocopies. The selected candidates are expected to join immediately. The selected candidate is liable to be posted anywhere in India. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview. The Institute reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of positions, or to fill up or not fill any or all the posts. Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification. The Institute's decision on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection and conduct of the interview is final; no query or correspondence will be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GBPNIHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 positions: 2 Research Officer, 1 Junior Project Fellow (JPF) and 1 Data entry Operator.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GBPNIHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online on or before 11:59 PM on 03 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Research Officer post?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Life Sciences/ Agriculture/ Horticulture with relevant experience of 3 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the JPF and Data entry Operator posts?
faq.answer: JPF needs a First Class Master degree in Botany/ Forestry/ Remote Sensing & GIS/ Ecology/ Environment Science/ Life Science or relevant discipline from a recognized university. Data entry Operator needs a graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years for Research Officer, 28 years for Junior Project Fellow and 35 years for Data entry Operator.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: Research Officer gets Rs. 50,000 + HRA, JPF gets Rs. 24,000 + HRA (as per norms), and Data entry Operator gets Rs 18,000 per month (fixed).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for GBPNIHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply through the online recruitment portal at https://gbpihed.gov.in/vacancy.php before the last date, then attend the walk-in interview if you have completed the online form.

faq.question: Q8. When and where is the interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 08 December 2026 from 10:00 am onwards at GBPNIHE, Kosi-Katarmal, Almora (Uttarakhand).

faq.question: Q9. Is the job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The positions are project-based and the engagement is purely temporary in nature.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.
